hero.title: Crafting Comfort Since 2024
hero.sub: Nilkanth Enterprises was born out of a desire for furniture that doesn't just fill a space, but tells a story of craftsmanship and durability.

philosophy.title: The Artisan Approach
paragraphs: We believe that every piece of wood has a soul. Our master craftsmen spend hundreds of hours selecting the finest teak, curing it to perfection, and hand-finishing every joint.
While the world moves toward mass-produced, temporary furniture, we stand firm on our promise of lifelong durability and 100% custom designs.

header.title: Our Growth Journey
header.sub: A vision of excellence, rapidly expanding to serve you better.

events.title: Songadh Branch
events.desc: Our journey began with the flagship showroom in Songadh, bringing premium custom furniture to the local community.

events.title: Nilkanth Factory Foundation
events.desc: To ensure 100% quality control, we established our own manufacturing unit, transitioning from a retailer to a factory-first brand.

events.title: Vyara Branch Expansion
events.desc: Responding to high demand, we opened our second major outlet in Vyara, specializing in luxury living and dining collections.

events.title: Bardoli Branch Launch
events.desc: Our most recent expansion into Bardoli, featuring a massive experience center for complete home renovations.

cta.title: Experience the Craft First-Hand
cta.text: Visit our factory in Vyara to see how your furniture is made. From raw timber to polished perfection.
